reason: 世界不平等实验室与 Inequality.org 称 2025 年全球最富 1% 占有 20.3% 的全球收入，并给出上升幅度；美国顶级财富集中仍处高位。但世界银行指出，全球（国家间）收入基尼在疫情前近三十年几乎持续下降。尾部/顶端集中与全球基尼走势并不一致，主结果只部分成立。
quote: because of modernity, the share of Extremistan is increasing.
claim: Due to modernity, the share of Extremistan—jump-driven, tail-dominated randomness—in socioeconomic life is increasing.

reason: Experimental History 2022 年综述指出，电影、电视、音乐、图书和游戏中，越来越小的超级明星卡特尔占据越来越大的市场份额，赢家通吃已从“分一杯羹”变成“通吃大半”；2025 年对文化领域幂律的复盘也支持头部更瘦、中腰更弱。方向在窗口内成立。
quote: Winner-take-all effects are worsening: success for an author, a company, an idea, a musician, an athlete is planetary, or nothing.
claim: Winner-take-all effects are getting worse: success for an author, company, idea, musician, or athlete is planetary or nothing.

reason: 2012 年后深度网络与大模型被广泛承认为黑箱，2023 年数字人文学刊与 2021 年 Minds and Machines 均指出决策机制不透明、可解释性不足；这与“对人造成物越来越缺乏理解”的方向一致。但缺乏可量化的理解能力指标，且可解释 AI 同时在发展，故记趋势符合而非正确。
quote: Our sophistication continuously puts us ahead of ourselves, creating things we are less and less capable of understanding.
claim: Human sophistication keeps creating things that people are less and less capable of understanding.

reason: LSE 与 EPIC 指出阿联酋 PISA 2022 数学/阅读/科学仍低于经合组织平均 41–59 分；IMF 2023 年仍称碳氢收入约占财政总收入 60%。教育开支并非完全无效：WIPO《2025 年全球创新指数》中阿联酋列第 30，非石油部门也有增长。因此“完全徒劳、无法转化为知识型繁荣”只部分成立。
quote: Their wealth came from oil, not from some vocational know-how, so I am certain that their spending on education is completely sterile and a great transfer of resources
claim: Oil-funded formal education spending by desert states such as Abu Dhabi will prove sterile and will not convert oil wealth into knowledge-generated prosperity; it is mainly a transfer of resources.

reason: 预测是可用药物池应缩小而非扩大。相反，FDA CDER 2025 年批准 46 种前所未有的新药；BioCentury 称截至 2026 年 10 月底新分子实体批准数已追平历史前十个月高点。窗口内新药持续进入市场，主结果与预测相反。
quote: we may be underestimating the interactions of current drugs, those already on the market, by a factor of four so, if anything, the pool of available drugs should be shrinking rather than growing.
claim: Because underestimated drug–drug interactions multiply with each new approval, the usable pool of available drugs should shrink rather than grow.

reason: “最终会崩溃”没有可检验的终点。联合国教科文组织 2026 年报告称全球高等教育在校生 2024 年达 2.69 亿，二十年间翻倍以上；英、美确有部分院校关闭或陷入财务危机，但建制教育体系并未崩溃。决定性事实尚未出现。
quote: Education is an institution that has been growing without external stressors; eventually the thing will collapse.
claim: Organized education, having grown as a status-luxury and rent-extracting institution without external stressors, will eventually collapse.

reason: 欧洲央行执委施纳贝尔 2023 年指出，疫情后两年半欧元区 M1 增长逾 30%，通胀从 1.2% 升至 9.1%，并于 2022 年 10 月见顶 10.6%；英国 IEA 汇编的 2022 年美、欧、英消费通胀约 8%。书中“先看似无效、再意外跳升”的序列在窗口内出现。局限是部分官方分析同时强调能源冲击与供给因素。
quote: central banks can print money; they print and print with no effect (and claim the “safety” of such a measure), then, “unexpectedly,” the printing causes a jump in inflation.
claim: After a period in which central-bank money printing appears to have no effect and is called safe, the printing will unexpectedly cause a jump in inflation.

reason: 窗口内出现新冠等极端冲击，但检索未得到“黑天鹅效应”在频率或强度上必然增强的可比较度量；国际货币基金组织等仍讨论 2008 年后的金融稳定，无法据此确认或否定“必然增强”。
quote: Black Swan effects are necessarily increasing, as a result of complexity, interdependence between parts, globalization, and the beastly thing called “efficiency” that makes people now sail too close to the wind.
claim: Because of rising complexity, interdependence, globalization, and efficiency that leaves little slack, Black Swan effects will keep increasing.

reason: CSI Magazine 转述 Sandvine《2024 年全球互联网现象报告》：谷歌、Facebook 与 Netflix 合计驱动全球固定和移动流量近 70%，集中度已远高于传统 80/20，但尚未达到书中的 99/1；图书方面长尾研究认为向利基的转移有限，亚马逊渠道份额很高。方向成立，终点未到，记趋势符合。
quote: Few realize that we are moving into the far more uneven distribution of 99/1 across many things that used to be 80/20: 99 percent of Internet traffic is attributable to less than 1 percent of sites, 99 percent of book sales come from less than 1 percent of authors
claim: Winner-take-all concentration is shifting from roughly 80/20 toward 99/1 in domains such as Internet traffic and book sales.

reason: 书中给出“再存活一个世纪”的明确长期限（约至 2112 年）。IEA 与 SLOCAT 显示 2025 年道路运输仍约占全球旅客周转量三分之二，德国 2025 年千人汽车保有量创新高；电动汽车仍属于汽车技术。技术并未消失，终点未到，记趋势符合。
quote: A single car is perishable, but the automobile as a technology has survived about a century (and we will speculate should survive another one).
claim: The automobile as a technology, having already lasted about a century, should survive another century.

reason: 面向约 2036 年的判断。截止日前，书架、电话和手工艺均仍存在：CNN 2026 年报道手工/模拟爱好升温，Dazed 2026 年仍在讨论有线电话的使用。终点未到，方向成立，记趋势符合。
quote: I would expect the future to be populated with wall-to-wall bookshelves, the device called the telephone, artisans, and such, using the notion that most technologies that are now twenty-five years old should be around in another twenty-five years—once again, most, not all.
claim: Looking toward 2036, most technologies already twenty-five years old in 2010–2012—including bookshelves, the telephone, and artisanal crafts—should still be around a further twenty-five years later.

reason: 同一 2036 练习的终点尚未到达。晨星 2026 年指出埃克森美孚、沃尔玛等 2012 年前后的巨头仍在存续甚至兴旺，苹果等继续位居市值前列；BCG 称 2005–2025 年多数行业的领导地位更替反而放缓。既不能说“今天的大公司应已消失”，也不能在终点前判错。
quote: Corporations that are large today should be gone, as they have always been weakened by what they think is their strength: size, which is the enemy of corporations as it causes disproportionate fragility to Black Swans.
claim: By the 2036 horizon of the same exercise, corporations that are large today should have disappeared, because size makes them disproportionately fragile to Black Swans.

reason: 新加坡、迪拜等城邦在窗口内明显存续并扩张（哈佛国际评论等）；但小型公司一端，独立商业研究显示亚马逊等平台挤压中小企业，新企业形成走弱的讨论也在持续。城邦部分更符合，小公司“甚至繁荣”并未普遍成立，故为部分符合。
quote: corporations are more likely to be around, even thrive.
claim: Continuing the 2036 Economist forecasts: city-states and small corporations are more likely to still be around, and even to thrive.

reason: 2036 视野下“权力被严重削弱”的终点未到。疫情与之后央行资产负债表和职责反而扩大（新政治经济学文献称其获得前所未有的权力），同时独立地位受到政治压力；民族国家在防疫、战争和产业政策中仍处核心。复合对象缺少决定性的“严重削弱”事实。
quote: The nation-state, the currencyprinting central bank, these things called economics departments, may stay nominally, but they will have their powers severely eroded.
claim: By the same 2036 horizon, the nation-state, currency-printing central banks, and economics departments may remain in name, but their powers will be severely eroded.

reason: 无日期的方向性判断，按出版至截止日窗口衡量。2023 年硅谷银行等事件后，美国法律评论 2026 年称机构救助已成为“新常态”，并点名储蓄信贷危机、次贷危机至 SVB、Signature；损失社会化和道德风险在窗口内持续甚至再现，主方向成立。
quote: The effects of transfers of fragility are becoming more acute, as modernity is building up more and more people on the left column—inverse heroes, so to say.
claim: Transfers of fragility and antifragility from one party to another are becoming more acute: modernity is producing more and more people who get the upside while others get the harm (the left column of his ethics Triad).

reason: 语境是比 2007–2008 年更大的危机。苏黎世理工学院 KOF 称新冠危机引发二战结束以来最严重的全球经济下滑；但德意志银行 2026 年综述认为 2008 年后并未再发生重大金融危机。短期实体收缩一度超过金融危机，金融体系式“更大爆破”并未出现，故为部分符合。
quote: No wonder we will have larger crises.
claim: Because economists who misunderstood rare-event risk and helped cause the 2007–2008 crisis then postdicted it and remained influential, society will experience larger crises than that one.

reason: “经济学家会再次把我们搞炸”没有期限。2021–22 年通胀被部分人归咎于货币政策误判，但窗口内没有出现与 2008 年相当、由经济学误判驱动的系统性金融崩盘；德意志银行 2026 年亦强调 2008 年后无重大金融危机。既不能判正确，也不宜仅因尚未发生而判错。
quote: It is a severe disease, one that explains why economists will blow us up again.
claim: The economics establishment’s misunderstanding of small probabilities is a severe disease that will cause another blow-up.

reason: “最终会自我毁灭”属于开放期限。可口可乐与百事可乐 2025 年年报仍显示高额营收与利润，大型制药公司在减肥药带动下继续扩张。个别企业受挫不等于这类公司已经自毁，终点未到。
quote: Of course they will eventually self-destruct, but that’s another conversation.
claim: Large commercial firms that can only grow by addition—pharmaceutical companies, health-club machine makers, stockbrokers, and similar revenue-growth-driven corporations—will eventually self-destruct.

reason: “长期如此脆弱、最终因代理问题崩溃”没有可检验终点。经合组织《2025 年公司治理概况》称 2024 年底全球约有 4.4 万家上市公司、总市值约 125 万亿美元；虽有 Carillion、硅谷银行等个案，公司形态并未崩溃。
quote: In sum, corporations are so fragile, long-term, that they eventually collapse under the weight of the agency problem, while managers milk them for bonuses and ditch the bones to taxpayers.
claim: Publicly listed corporations are so fragile in the long term that they eventually collapse under the agency problem, while managers take bonuses and leave the losses to taxpayers.

reason: 窗口内花旗集团并未再次破产或接受 2008 年式救助。惠誉 2025 年 8 月确认长期发行人评级为 A、展望稳定；晨星 DBRS 2026 年 2 月确认长期评级 A（高）、展望稳定，并指 2025 年经营改善。主结果与“将再次爆破”相反。括号中纳税人补贴奥尔萨格高薪亦无新的救助式证据。
quote: Citibank will blow up again (and we taxpayers will end up subsidizing his high salary).
claim: Citibank (Citigroup) will blow up again after the 2008 crisis, and taxpayers will end up subsidizing Peter Orszag’s high salary there (he had become vice chairman after co-authoring the Fannie Mae risk assessment Taleb criticizes).

reason: Bloomberg Law 2017 年统计，2016 年初以来离职的 26 名SEC高官中，超过一半进入律所或金融机构；另有商品期货交易委员会市场监管前负责人、货币监理前署长等多起转任律所的公开报道。约 2300 页级复杂监管成为前监管者的“金矿”，在窗口内得到证实。冷却期规则并未阻止这一通道。
quote: Twenty-three hundred pages of regulation— something I can replace with Hammurabi’s rule—will be a gold mine for former regulators.
claim: Highly complex regulation on the order of twenty-three hundred pages will be a gold mine for former regulators, who can later exploit its loopholes in private employment.

reason: 大数据与机器学习中的虚假相关在 2012 年后成为持续扩大的研究主题（过参数化加剧虚假相关、高维回归等）；可重复性危机的大规模复现项目仍报告低再现率。开放科学带来一些程序改进，但并未否定“数据量增大、虚假信息更快增长”的方向，记趋势符合。
quote: The fooled-by-data effect is accelerating.
claim: The fooled-by-data effect—spurious relationships rising faster than real information as datasets grow—is accelerating, especially under Big Data.
